annotations.title: Translate text API: any language to any language with detection

description: Translate text between languages with an open LLM (gpt-oss-20b; M2M100 for less common languages): the source language is detected, the target is an ISO code such as en, sv, de, fr, es, zh or ja, and long text is split at sentence ends and checked so a cut-off translation is never charged. Use to localise messages, documents, product copy and support replies. Example: text=Payment received, thank you!, to=sv. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
